name: biodesigner-desktop
description: Electron shell for BioDesigner: serves the built renderer and runs the back-end in the main process.

scripts.//start: Serves the static renderer from front-end/out — the shape a packaged build runs in.
scripts.//dev: Loads the Next dev server for HMR — run `npm run dev:renderer` at the root first.
scripts.//typecheck: esbuild only strips types, so this is the real check.
scripts.//package: Builds the .app/.dmg. The renderer and back-end must already be built — use the root `npm run package`, which enforces the order.

//electron: Pinned, not ranged: electron-builder needs an exact version to fetch matching binaries, and runtime upgrades should be deliberate.
//back-end: devDependency on purpose: esbuild inlines it, so nothing needs it at runtime.
//name: Drives app.getName() and so the userData path — keep it aligned with productName in electron-builder.yml, or a packaged build reads a different sessions directory than a dev one.
author: Mau Ulisse Luz
